claim_provenance.claim: Survey results show private-equity dealmakers are significantly more likely than corporates to expect M&A pipeline activity to increase relative to 2025.
Compared with corporates, private-equity dealmakers are significantly more likely to expect M&A pipeline activity to increase versus 2025.
Across displayed size bands for estimated total deal value of the next M&A transaction, the below-US$1B bands total 81% for corporate estimates and 94% for private-equity estimates.
For deal types under consideration, carve-out acquisitions are displayed at 21% for Corporate and 55% for Private equity, with a displayed +34 percentage-point difference.

The report says organizations are sharpening portfolio focus to concentrate capital, capabilities, and management attention where they believe they can build durable advantage in a more complex global environment.
In its deal-execution discussion, the report argues that AI expands analysis by making new categories of analysis worth doing, rather than merely accelerating existing analysis.
